controls.null_control: sealed Phase7 no-positive sample re-used only as a procedural withholding control, never a qualified fire-free reference
controls.source_negative: all qualified same-pass shared-support observations with both native masks5; satellite-classified non-detection controls, not independent physical fire absence
controls.spatial_control_limits: same granules, no assumption that absence of incident record means fire-free; diagnostic outcomes only

event_rule: agency report UTC date plus6 subsequent UTC days, fixed0.8deg longitude /0.25deg latitude tract around event inside parent development; north clipped at55N

fit.reason: two-pass enriched feasibility cannot justify model or generalization

frozen_before: all Phase8 CMR search and L2 outcome inspection

geometry.acceptance: independent geometry agrees within1e-6 relative area and edge uncertainty is documented; otherwise qualified area null
geometry.aoi: ellipsoidal LAEA clipped, half-open center membership only for descriptive baseline
geometry.dedup: same source, acquisition key and native row/sample once; union overlapping physical support, never sum duplicate areas
geometry.requirement: oriented instrument/geolocation-derived footprints with justified boundary uncertainty; never GRings or center spacing as physical support

holdouts: original Portugal/California and Canada2024 sealed; only existing southern Canada June2023 development

independent_event.limits: approximate agency point and report date, >=200ha service subset; dated estimated perimeter is not instantaneous active flaming extent; satellite-derived perimeter components may not be fully independent
independent_event.map_evidence: NASA web search cached Alberta Incident Command GIS public map dated2023-06-10, accessed as text; direct PDF retrieval not yet established

lineage_boundary: 2023 native61.03 separate from2022 literal6.03. Exact current L2061 and C2 inputs required; no unproved join to FIRMS row production vintage.

metrics.B0: source-separated raw reported positives and FRP MW, no adjustment
metrics.B1: positive pixels and FRP within qualified shared physical support only
metrics.B2: 750m identity baseline versus interpretable candidate; no fit in this two-pass feasibility study
metrics.B4: no FRP correction absent sufficient qualified positive pairs and physical uncertainty
metrics.uncertainty: finite selected-catalog counts exact, geometry/view/time/boundary sensitivities descriptive; no model CI without qualified replicated samples

prior_knowledge: Phase5 context native-month counts already visible and disclosed; this is enriched descriptive development, not blind evaluation. No agreement/ratio/FRP used to rank passes.

qa.MYD14: exact C6/C6.1 mask/landwater, contextual quality and geolocation flags; known table4 fields, no375m borrowing
qa.VNP14: require exact C2 applicability evidence; decode any historical-table sensitivity explicitly UNQUALIFIED until established
qa.VNP14IMG: C2 guide v1.2 inputs bits0..6 nominal, bit22 residual bowtie excluded, geo flags0; validland/fire classes5/7/8/9, water/glint/cloud excluded

selection.negative_result: stop after frozen2 candidates; never replace by observed agreement or intensity
selection.time_screen: max separation of any granule interval endpoints <=10min; midpoint <=5min; actual pixel timing or conservative bounds required
